name: Eliasaph
overview: The name Eliasaph appears in Scripture as a leader associated with different tribes, notably Gad and the Gershonites. Several verses identify Eliasaph as the son of Deuel, who served as a prince and captain over the tribe of Gad, responsible for leading and offering sacrifices (Numbers 1:14; 2:14; 7:42; 7:47; 10:20). Additionally, Eliasaph is named as the son of Lael, a chief of the house of the Gershonites (Numbers 3:24). These references highlight Eliasaph's role in God-ordained leadership and service within Israel's tribal structure.
